opening: My arms and legs have become weak.
The weakness, swallowing trouble, drooling, nausea and vomiting have been going on for four days.
I can't move the muscles of my face properly, on both sides.
A month ago I had my first dose of an inactivated COVID-19 vaccine.

opening.text: My arms and legs have become weak, and I have trouble swallowing. I've been drooling and feeling nauseated. I can't move the muscles of my face properly, on both sides.
